SpaceX Reportedly in Talks for Pentagon Computing Power Deal

Reports indicate that Elon Musk's SpaceX is in discussions with the Pentagon to provide computing power. The Wall Street Journal reported that these talks are ongoing and could potentially fail. The specifics of the potential deal and its implications remain unclear.
